final: WITH g AS (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT g.raceId, g.cnt, g.cnt*1.0/t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL), d AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.cnt, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS diff FROM r JOIN a ON a.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT raceId, cnt, ratio, diff FROM d ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
